info.name: Pact Boons
info.description: The construction for my custom Pact Boons.
info.author: Gustavo Schip

description.p: When you select this boon, you gain a special tattoo or mark from your patron. It can be made in their visage or be a symbol that represents them. As a bonus action you can use the mark to regain a warlock spell slot. You can do this once per long rest.
